description: This file defines the final class HeaderSecurity, which provides static methods for filtering and validating HTTP header values to prevent injection attacks and ensure compliance with RFC 7230. It includes methods for filtering header values, validating them, and asserting their validity, as well as validating header names.

classes.name: HeaderSecurity
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods to filter and validate HTTP headers for security purposes, such as preventing injection vectors and ensuring compliance with RFC standards.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters a header value to remove potential injection vectors by allowing only visible ASCII characters, spaces, horizontal tabs, and properly formatted continuation sequences per RFC 7230.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if a header value is valid according to RFC 7230, ensuring it contains only permitted characters and proper line termination sequences.

methods.name: assertValid
methods.description: Asserts that a header value is valid and of acceptable type (string or numeric); throws an exception if invalid.

methods.name: assertValidName
methods.description: Validates a header name against allowed characters and throws an exception if invalid.
